sections.summary: Optional one-line summary shown under the heading.
sections.content:
## Integer Data Types

C provides `char`, `short`, `int`, `long` and `long long`.

```c
int x = 10;
printf("%d", x);
```

Math works too: $x^2$ and $$\frac{a}{b}$$.

## Type Conversion

Implicit conversion is automatic; a cast such as `(float)x` is explicit.
